description: List integrity incidents across all of Robinhood's stock tokens, newest first: one call to monitor them all. An incident is a token whose supply or treasury balance diverged from its full mint/burn ledger, or a ledger rebaseline, with its type, status and block window. type=integrity (default), operational (collector errors) or all. On-chain observations and reconciliation findings, not financial advice. For one token's open integrity flags, use get_token_summary.

limit.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 20). Not refused when outside: above 100 is cut to 100, below 1 becomes 1, as on the HTTP routes.

name: list_incidents
title: List integrity incidents
